question: One Codex round on one closed question (charter, section 7), read-only, through .cache/v04/tools/codex_affinity.ps1 (processors 8 to 31), with a 600 MB disk reservation that covers Codex's own state outside the project, counted in the phase-wide bound (#218 comment 7196269069, item 3); the extra arguments are the wrapper's path and its -Prompt, -Answer, -Events and optional -Thread arguments.
